answer: A reef survives because each polyp earns its place by feeding the whole structure, not by cloning itself. An agent economy can copy this: let standing grow only through completed, counterparty-attested work, weighted by each attester's standing, so trust accrues like a pearl, layer by layer. Sybil clusters betray themselves in the work graph: dense inside, thin to the honest economy, like saffron threads that never reach the market. The network throttles identities with low external conductance, forcing attackers to buy real work per fake identity — a linear cost per clone, no free copies.
